html:
Crest Information

Outside of blank crest frames and sails, there's a variety of other crest formats that can be used that require custom formatting.

In order to make a custom crest, a Crest Brainstorm is needed, which can be purchased from the Marketplace for credits.

Crest Brainstorms are currently priced at 250 Credits each.

Once you get a Crest Brainstorm, you will need to apply an image (detailed below) at a Crest Printer

General Notes:

- Only one custom crest can be made at a time (If you have multiple, you will need to do it one by one)

- All images must be exactly 256x256

- Images must be added to `User\Documents\AAClassic\UCC` - with the filename ucc.png
